svg.title: AI Managed Evidence Pipeline — architecture
svg.desc: Autonomous pipeline from audio capture through Whisper transcription, prompt-cached Claude routing, into emergent Drive sub-folders, with fail-safe paths.
svg.text: Autonomous audio-to-archive pipeline. Solid lines = happy path. Dashed = fail-safe paths.
Each stage has a defined fallback so the pipeline never silently drops evidence.

g.text: No prompt per file. Folder watcher
Cost scales with volume, not with
